_comment: Pricing calibration. The engine multiplies each component by the factor that applies to it, so a generated quote can be brought into line with the agency's published package prices without touching the rate card itself. Produced by `npm run calibrate -- --write`, and safe to hand-edit afterwards — your edits survive the next run unless you pass --write again.
_howToUse: Run `npm run calibrate` to see how every published package prices today. Where the generated price is wrong, either correct the underlying rate in Pricing_Rules.xlsx (best), or set a factor here (fastest). A factor of 1.0 is neutral; 1.15 makes that component 15% dearer.
_precedence: package > country > region > global. The first match wins, they do not compound.
